subject: general
question: How many ministers, including Prime Minister Mr Narendra Modi, took the oath of Cabinet Minister, Minister of States with Independent charge and Minister of State respectively, on the occasion of the oath-taking ceremony which was held at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi on 30/05/2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25, 9, 24**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On** May 30, 2019**, a total of **57 ministers took the oath of office** at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi.
 
• Among these, **25 were sworn in as Cabinet Ministers**, including Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• **9 **ministers took the oath as **Ministers of State** (Independent Charge).
 
• **24 **ministers were sworn in as **Ministers of State**.
 
• This ceremony marked the beginning of the second term of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cabinet Minister:** These are senior ministers in charge of major ministries and are part of the Cabinet Committee on Political Affairs.
 
• **Minister of State (Independent Charge):** These ministers handle specific portfolios independently and do not report to a Cabinet Minister.
 
• **Minister of State:** These ministers assist Cabinet Ministers in their respective departments and portfolios.
 
• **Oath of Office:** The oath-taking ceremony is a formal process where ministers pledge to uphold the Constitution and discharge their duties faithfully.
 
• **Rashtrapati Bhavan:** The official residence of the President of India, where significant state functions, including swearing-in ceremonies, take place.
